english.title: Aircraft commander / tug driver fail to stop after aircraft accident within Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Gatwick Airport - London to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..), being the

(A)_[commander of an aircraft,]_
(B)_[tug driver of a towed aircraft,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), who was present at the time the aircraft was involved in an accident failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the person who was the operator of the aircraft at the time of the accident, the identification marks of the aircraft and details of the accident to a constable through the published airport telephone number as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 10(3)(a) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
